observed: quantile_coverage cov90 by resolution: 1min 0.880-0.898 (0 cells >0.90), 15s 0.881-0.901 (1 cell =0.901), 1s 0.884-0.913 (3 cells >0.90). At provisioning cadences (15s,1min) the range 0.880-0.901 rounds to [0.88,0.90] to 2 dp.
claimed: p90 band edge empirically calibrated, coverage 0.88-0.90
evidence: The passage frames the band as what 'converts forecasts into provisionable headroom' (provisioning cadence). At 15s and 1min the coverage is 0.880-0.901, captured by [0.88,0.90] to 2 dp; only the non-provisioning 1s cadence reaches 0.913.
fix: Add the qualifier 'at provisioning cadence' (coverage owned by quantile_coverage, not forecast_metrics); the 1-second forecast cadence reaches cov90=0.913 and is out of scope for the provisioning band.
query: WITH cells AS (SELECT e.key res,(e.value->>'cov90')::float cov90 FROM quantile_coverage q CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(q.detail) e) SELECT res,min(cov90),max(cov90),count(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90>0.90) FROM cells GROUP BY res;
